beats.headline: Read, not sold
beats.text: Donut has a spellbook coming to her, and remembering it, she rushes to the mailbox in the restaurant's shadowy corner, opens it, and grunts. When is she going to get a good spell, something with some kick, like Fireball? For once she asks Mordecai whether to read it or sell it. Read it, he says, and she glows. It is a spell called Hole, he explains, and it does exactly what it sounds like: a temporary hole on a surface of her choosing. A level-one hole is not thick enough to get through most doors, but it is a useful spell, especially if she is creative. Carl can already think of half a dozen uses.

beats.headline: On three
beats.text: The war mage Dismember stands on the far side of Carl's metal plate, promising to peel the skin off them and keep them alive afterwards. Carl lets him talk and counts on his fingers. On three, a hole appears in the metal. Carl reaches through, grabs the surprised elf-like creature by his long silver hair and pulls, and the moment the head is through, Donut snaps the spell off. The severed head drops to the floor with its mouth still open wide.

beats.headline: The bottom of the basket
beats.text: In the balloon basket with the gnomes, missiles in the air, two of Katia's spikes burst from the bundle and pierce the wicker, anchoring her, and Donut casts Hole in the bottom of the basket right underneath all of them. She has practised it up to a meter and a half across, which makes it thinner, and that does not matter here. The three gnomes drop through, astonished, as Crixus's grenade ball flies wide over Carl's shoulder; Carl pulls his feet up onto the bench. At the last moment Leon grabs the edge of the hole, until an ethereal cat paw pushes him off.

beats.headline: Under her own feet
beats.text: The dog's jaws close right through Donut. There were five Donuts, not four, and she had laid the middle illusion over herself. She had also downed an invisibility potion, and she had cast Hole under her own feet just as the dog lunged. The view changes to the outside, and a translucent outline of Donut drops straight down and lands deftly on the ground beside the burning tree. Carl cannot believe that worked.
